scope: Source review decisions only; no linked or runtime acceptance inferred.

BinkMovie/BINKMovie.cpp.classification: platform replacement with missing presentation contract
BinkMovie/BINKMovie.cpp.reason: Native Play accepts but discards subtitle_name and FontCharsClass arguments. Decode dependency also has a confirmed transform-enum truncation defect with the installed compiler defaults.
BinkMovie/BINKMovie.cpp.remaining: Restore original subtitle ownership at the movie boundary; fix FFmpeg enum layout consistently with its sole Bink consumer. Compile and link both before any future playback acceptance.

Combat/statemachine.cpp.reason: Translation unit only includes statemachine.h; template implementation is consumed by boss headers.
Combat/statemachine.cpp.remaining: Verify boss owner selection in canonical target.

Combat/directinput.cpp.reason: Original DirectInput interface is implemented at the Vita controller boundary, including button arrays, cursor, acquisition and Read.
Combat/directinput.cpp.remaining: Audit complete interface and native target selection; physical controls unaccepted.

Combat/debug.cpp.reason: Boundary supplies selected DebugManager fields and display methods; this is not evidence that the complete original debug implementation is restored.
Combat/debug.cpp.remaining: Compare original interface and callers; retain required diagnostic behavior and classify omitted desktop facilities.

wwui/IMEManager.cpp.classification: native text-entry replacement with shared edit-control routing
wwui/IMEManager.cpp.reason: Shared EditCtrl opens native entry on click or dialog activation, consumes UTF-16 results through Set_Text and original change notification, and cancels by owner on destruction. Chat explicitly opens the same control. Desktop composition observers are intentionally disabled; the native firmware dialog owns composition. Both adapter sources are listed in canonical CMake.
wwui/IMEManager.cpp.remaining: Verify selected native target and link; audit original edit-control filtering semantics on whole-string native results. Physical text-entry acceptance remains open under the play-test hold.
